[EN] All young amani craft a weapon as part of their hushang. It's usually decorative, but I might make one that works.

That would take a little longer, though.
[ES] Todos los jóvenes amani fabrican un arma como parte de su hushang. Suele ser decorativa, pero tal vez haga una que funcione.

Aunque eso tomaría un poco más de tiempo.
